endpoints.name: ListAllInteractions
endpoints.description: Retrieves all interactions with basic pagination and ordering (no search criteria). This endpoint provides a general list of interactions. For specific searches, use the `/api/interactions/search` or `/api/interactions/advanced-search` endpoints.

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List all interactions in the system

endpoints.name: SearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple interaction fields (subject, description, etc.). This endpoint is for basic keyword searches. For more complex, structured, or relationship-based searches, use the `/api/interactions/advanced-search` endpoint. The `searchText` parameter allows for a general keyword search.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchText.description: Text to search across interaction subject, description, and other basic fields

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple keyword searches across interaction content. NOT for relationship-based searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, contacts, dates, and complex filters. Use the `searchCriteria` parameter to specify a JSON array of search objects. Each object should have `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. For example: `[{"field":"type","operator":"is","value":"Meeting"},{"field":"date","operator":"between","value":"2024-01-01,2024-12-31"}]`. Available fields for search include: `id`, `contactId`, `type`, `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `description`, `subject`, `contactName`, `contactFirstName`, `contactLastName`, `contactEmail`, `partnerName`, `partnerStatus`. Nested fields like `contact.firstName`, `contact.lastName`, `partner.name` are also available. Operators include: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields are `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`. The `searchText` parameter can be used for an additional general keyword search alongside structured criteria.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Show meetings with John Smith contact
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner relationships, contact details, dates, interaction types, or multiple field combinations.
